_doc: The Atlas Journal app manifest: daily journal entries, end-to-end encrypted. Its kinds are namespaced `journal.<kind>`. Journal v1 is personal: the server never fans its ops out to another account and reads none of their fields, so every field value is encrypted (no plaintext_fields). `journal.entry` is one entry (date, title, body, mood, tags, …), `journal.preference` one of the app's settings. Bump `version` whenever the kinds or their plaintext fields change.
name: Atlas Journal
